title: Expedia Hotels Listings Scraper
description: Extract Expedia hotel listing cards from Hotel-Search results with prices, ratings, and property links.

startUrl.title: Expedia Hotel-Search URL
startUrl.description: Optional direct Expedia Hotel-Search URL. Leave empty to build the request from the manual filters below.

regionId.title: Region ID
regionId.description: Expedia region ID used when startUrl is not provided.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination label used in Expedia search query.

children.title: Children ages
children.description: Comma-separated child ages for room 1, for example: 4,8

results_wanted.title: Maximum listings
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of hotel listings to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum page loads
max_pages.description: Maximum result-load rounds to attempt while scrolling/loading more.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is strongly recommended for reliable extraction.
